_about: Live STANCES (lanePARRY, rebalanced by laneSTANCE2), read by StanceLayer.cs + AiStance.cs. Every number is a multiplier on the Neutral value (1 = unchanged). Off in steer mode (-steer: STStanceMods / steer.json stances own it there). BOTH fighters' stances apply to every blow. DAMAGE: FightBalance.HitMul = attacker dealtMul x defender takenMul x Trickster rolls. POSTURE (STANCE2): attacker postureDealtMul x defender postureTakenMul on a clean hit, a block and a kick into a guard (a parry's attacker posture is NOT stance-scaled: the parry stays the equaliser); with rollsScalePosture a Trickster proc scales that same hit's posture too. GUARD: guardArcMul widens/narrows the block cone (60 deg x), parryWindowMul scales the parry window (parry.json windowTicks, rounded, >= 1), blockCostMul = stamina a block costs, blockChipMul = chip damage through a block. TEMPO: attackCostMul = stamina per swing (stamina.json costs), moveSpeedMul = walk/run/guard-walk speed. feintCostMul = V feint cost (Trickster 0.5). Trickster: pDealt chance of dealtRollMul on damage dealt, pTaken chance of takenRollMul on damage taken (owner: 25 % +30 % / 25 % +30 %, mean x1.075 each way). Trade-offs: AGGRESSIVE +15 % damage, +35 % posture dealt; pays +10 % damage taken, +20 % posture taken, a 15 % narrower block cone, a 10 % shorter parry window, blocks cost +25 %, block chip +50 %, swings cost +25 % stamina. DEFENSIVE +30 % parry window, +15 % block cone, blocks cost -20 %, chip -40 %, takes -15 % damage and -12 % posture; pays -10 % damage and -20 % posture dealt, 12 % slower. NEUTRAL = baseline. Numbers chosen with _agents/laneSTANCE2/tools/stance_sim.py (posture + HP race calibrated on the 47 regime-D fights): no stance row-mean differs from Neutral by more than 2 points at 55 % overall. switchLockS: a human cannot switch again within that many seconds (the AI uses ai.minDwellS). keepLethalDeathblow: Duel keeps a lethal deathblow lethal after multipliers < 1. ai: the AI fighter picks its own stance (AiStance.cs): Defensive when own HP <= lowHpEnter or own posture >= selfPostureEnter (kept until HP > lowHpExit and posture <= selfPostureExit); else Aggressive when the foe's posture >= oppPostureEnter or own HP lead >= leadEnter (kept until foe posture <= oppPostureExit and lead <= leadExit); else Trickster with tricksterChance per decision (held tricksterHoldS s); else Neutral. Decided every decideEveryS s, never before minDwellS s after a change. enabled false = aiStance fixed. forAutoplayPlayer also drives the IsPlayer fighter when AIBrain runs it (-autoplay); the balance bot (FlowBot) never switches: set playerDefault to sweep it. Input: nextKeys / prevKeys (3 / 4), mouse wheel (wheelCooldownS), gamepad D-pad (padAxisX = Input Manager axis 'DPadX', undefined axes switch themselves off), padNextButtons / padPrevButtons. HUD: bottom-left label + a short centre toast on a human switch.
